1.english_reference: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD at Jerusalem in mount Moriah

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֣חֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לִ בְנ֤וֹת אֶת בֵּית יְהוָה֙ בִּ יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בְּ הַר֙ הַ מּ֣וֹרִיָּ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἤρξατο Σαλωμὼν τοῦ οἰκοδομεῖν τὸν οἶκον Κυρίου ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἐν ὄρει τοῦ Ἁμορειά
traditions.VUL: Et cœpit Sálomon ædificáre domum Dómini in Ierúsalem in monte Mória ,
traditions.KJV: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD at Jerusalem in mount Moriah ,

1.english_reference: where [ the LORD ] appeared unto David his father

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִרְאָ֖ה לְ דָוִ֣יד אָבִ֑י
traditions.LXX: οὗ ὤφθη Κύριος τῷ Δαυεὶδ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: qui demonstrátus fúerat David patri eius ,
traditions.KJV: where [ the LORD ] appeared unto David his father ,

1.english_reference: in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite

traditions.WLC: הוּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵכִין֙ בִּ מְק֣וֹם דָּוִ֔יד בְּ גֹ֖רֶן אָרְנָ֥ן הַ יְבוּסִֽי
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῷ τόπῳ ᾧ ἡτοίμασεν Δαυεὶδ ἐν ἅλῳ Ὀρνὰ τοῦ Ἰεβουσαίου .
traditions.VUL: in loco , quem paráverat David in área Ornan Iebusǽi .
traditions.KJV: in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite .

2.english_reference: And he began to build in the second [ day ] of the second month

traditions.WLC: וַ֠ יָּחֶל לִ בְנ֞וֹת בַּ חֹ֤דֶשׁ הַ שֵּׁנִי֙ בַּ שֵּׁנִ֔י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤρξατο οἰκοδομὴ ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ δευτέρῳ
traditions.VUL: Cœpit autem ædificáre mense secúndo ,
traditions.KJV: And he began to build in the second [ day ] of the second month ,

2.english_reference: in the fourth year of his reign

traditions.WLC: בִּ שְׁנַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֖ע לְ מַלְכוּתֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ τετάρτῳ τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: anno quarto regni sui .
traditions.KJV: in the fourth year of his reign .

3.english_reference: Now these [ are the things wherein ] Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֨לֶּה֙ הוּסַ֣ד שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה לִ בְנ֖וֹת אֶת בֵּ֣ית הָ אֱלֹהִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ταῦτα ἤρξατο Σαλωμὼν τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: Et hæc sunt fundaménta , quæ iecit Sálomon , ut ædificáret domum Dei :
traditions.KJV: Now these [ are the things wherein ] Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God .

3.english_reference: The length by cubits after the first measure [ was ] threescore cubits

traditions.WLC: הָ אֹ֡רֶךְ אַמּ֞וֹת בַּ מִּדָּ֤ה הָ רִֽאשׁוֹנָה֙ אַמּ֣וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֔ים
traditions.LXX: μῆκος πήχεων ἡ διαμέτρησις ἡ πρώτη πήχεων ἑξήκοντα ,
traditions.VUL: longitúdinis cúbitos in mensúra prima sexagínta ,
traditions.KJV: The length by cubits after the first measure [ was ] threescore cubits ,

traditions.WLC: וְ רֹ֖חַב אַמּ֥וֹת עֶשְׂרִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ εὖρος πήχεων εἴκοσι .
traditions.VUL: latitúdinis cúbitos vigínti .
traditions.KJV: and the breadth twenty cubits .

4.english_reference: And the porch that [ was ] in the front [ of the house ] , the length [ of it was ] according to the breadth of the house , twenty cubits

traditions.WLC: וְ הָ אוּלָ֡ם אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל פְּנֵ֨י הָ אֹ֜רֶךְ עַל פְּנֵ֤י רֹֽחַב הַ בַּ֨יִת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ αἰλὰμ κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ οἴκου , μῆκος ἐπὶ πρόσωπον πλάτος τοῦ οἴκου πήχεων εἴκοσι ,
traditions.VUL: Pórticum vero ante frontem , quæ tendebátur in longum iuxta mensúram latitúdinis domus , cubitórum vigínti :
traditions.KJV: And the porch that [ was ] in the front [ of the house ] , the length [ of it was ] according to the breadth of the house , twenty cubits ,

4.english_reference: and the height [ was ] an hundred and twenty

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ גֹּ֖בַהּ מֵאָ֣ה וְ עֶשְׂרִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὕψος πήχεων ἑκατὸν εἴκοσι ·
traditions.VUL: porro altitúdo centum vigínti cubitórum erat :
traditions.KJV: and the height [ was ] an hundred and twenty :

4.english_reference: and he overlaid it within with pure gold

traditions.WLC: וַ יְצַפֵּ֥ הוּ מִ פְּנִ֖ימָה זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατεχρύσωσεν αὐτὸν ἔσωθεν χρυσίῳ καθαρῷ .
traditions.VUL: et deaurávit eam intrínsecus auro mundíssimo .
traditions.KJV: and he overlaid it within with pure gold .

5.english_reference: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֣ת הַ בַּ֣יִת הַ גָּד֗וֹל חִפָּה֙ עֵ֣ץ בְּרוֹשִׁ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸν οἶκον τὸν μέγαν ἐξύλωσεν ξύλοις κεδρίνοις ,
traditions.VUL: Domum quoque maiórem texit tábulis lígneis abiégnis ,
traditions.KJV: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree ,

5.english_reference: which he overlaid with fine gold

traditions.WLC: וַ יְחַפֵּ֖ הוּ זָהָ֣ב ט֑וֹב
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατεχρύσωσεν χρυσίῳ καθαρῷ ,
traditions.VUL: et láminas auri obrízi affíxit per totum :
traditions.KJV: which he overlaid with fine gold ,

5.english_reference: and set thereon palm trees and chains

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֧עַל עָלָ֛י ו תִּמֹרִ֖ים וְ שַׁרְשְׁרֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔγλυψεν ἐπ᾽ αὐτοῦ φοίνικας καὶ χαλαστά .
traditions.VUL: sculpsítque in ea palmas , et quasi caténulas se ínvicem complecténtes .
traditions.KJV: and set thereon palm trees and chains .

6.english_reference: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty

traditions.WLC: וַ יְצַ֧ף אֶת הַ בַּ֛יִת אֶ֥בֶן יְקָרָ֖ה לְ תִפְאָ֑רֶת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκόσμησεν τὸν οἶκον λίθοις τιμίοις εἰς δόξαν ,
traditions.VUL: Stravit quoque paviméntum templi pretiosíssimo mármore , decóre multo .
traditions.KJV: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty :

6.english_reference: and the gold [ was ] gold of Parvaim

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ זָּהָ֖ב זְהַ֥ב פַּרְוָֽיִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ χρυσίῳ χρυσίου τοῦ ἐκ Φαρουάιμ ,
traditions.KJV: and the gold [ was ] gold of Parvaim .

7.english_reference: He overlaid also the house , the beams , the posts , and the walls thereof , and the doors thereof , with gold

traditions.WLC: וַ יְחַ֨ף אֶת הַ בַּ֜יִת הַ קֹּר֧וֹת הַ סִּפִּ֛ים וְ קִֽירוֹתָ֥י ו וְ דַלְתוֹתָ֖י ו זָהָ֑ב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐχρύσωσεν τὸν οἶκον καὶ τοὺς τοίχους καὶ τοὺς πυλῶνας καὶ τὰ ὀροφώματα καὶ τὰ θυρώματα χρυσίῳ ,
traditions.VUL: Porro aurum erat probatíssimum , de cuius láminis texit domum , et trabes eius , et postes , et paríetes , et óstia :
traditions.KJV: He overlaid also the house , the beams , the posts , and the walls thereof , and the doors thereof , with gold ;

7.english_reference: and graved cherubims on the walls

traditions.WLC: וּ פִתַּ֥ח כְּרוּבִ֖ים עַל הַ קִּירֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔγλυψεν χερουβεὶν ἐπὶ τῶν τοίχων .
traditions.VUL: et cælávit chérubim in pariétibus .
traditions.KJV: and graved cherubims on the walls .

8.english_reference: And he made the most holy house

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֨עַשׂ֙ אֶת בֵּֽית קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ קֳּדָשִׁ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸν οἶκον τοῦ ἁγίου τῶν ἁγίων ,
traditions.VUL: Fecit quoque domum Sancti sanctórum :
traditions.KJV: And he made the most holy house ,

8.english_reference: the length whereof [ was ] according to the breadth of the house , twenty cubits

traditions.WLC: אָרְכּ֞ וֹ עַל פְּנֵ֤י רֹֽחַב הַ בַּ֨יִת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: μῆκος αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ πρόσωπον , πλάτος πήχεων εἴκοσι ,
traditions.VUL: longitúdinem iuxta latitúdinem domus cubitórum vigínti :
traditions.KJV: the length whereof [ was ] according to the breadth of the house , twenty cubits ,

8.english_reference: and the breadth thereof twenty cubits

traditions.WLC: וְ רָחְבּ֖ וֹ אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ μῆκος πήχεων εἴκοσι ,
traditions.VUL: et latitúdinem simíliter vigínti cubitórum :
traditions.KJV: and the breadth thereof twenty cubits :

8.english_reference: and he overlaid it with fine gold , [ amounting ] to six hundred talents

traditions.WLC: וַ יְחַפֵּ֨ הוּ֙ זָהָ֣ב ט֔וֹב לְ כִכָּרִ֖ים שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐχρύσωσεν αὐτὸν χρυσίῳ καθαρῷ εἰς χερουβεὶν εἰς τάλαντα ἑξακόσια .
traditions.VUL: et láminis áureis texit eam , quasi taléntis sexcéntis .
traditions.KJV: and he overlaid it with fine gold , [ amounting ] to six hundred talents .

9.english_reference: And the weight of the nails [ was ] fifty shekels of gold

traditions.WLC: וּ מִשְׁקָ֛ל לְ מִסְמְר֥וֹת לִ שְׁקָלִ֖ים חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים זָהָ֑ב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὁλκὴ τῶν ἥλων , ὁλκὴ τοῦ ἑνὸς πεντήκοντα σίκλοι χρυσίου ·
traditions.VUL: Sed et clavos fecit áureos , ita ut sínguli clavi siclos quinquagénos appénderent :
traditions.KJV: And the weight of the nails [ was ] fifty shekels of gold .

9.english_reference: And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold

traditions.WLC: וְ הָ עֲלִיּ֖וֹת חִפָּ֥ה זָהָֽב
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ ὑπερῷον ἐχρύσωσεν χρυσίῳ .
traditions.VUL: cœnácula quoque texit auro .
traditions.KJV: And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold .

10.english_reference: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֜עַשׂ בְּ בֵֽית קֹ֤דֶשׁ הַ קֳּדָשִׁים֙ כְּרוּבִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה צַעֲצֻעִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τῷ ἁγίῳ τῶν ἁγίων χερουβεὶν δύο , ἔργον ἐκ ξύλων ,
traditions.VUL: Fecit étiam in domo Sancti sanctórum chérubim duos , ópere statuário :
traditions.KJV: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְצַפּ֥וּ אֹתָ֖ ם זָהָֽב
traditions.LXX: ἐχρύσωσεν αὐτὰ χρυσίῳ .
traditions.VUL: et texit eos auro .
traditions.KJV: and overlaid them with gold .

11.english_reference: And the wings of the cherubims [ were ] twenty cubits long

traditions.WLC: וְ כַנְפֵי֙ הַ כְּרוּבִ֔ים אָרְכָּ֖ ם אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ αἱ πτέρυγες τῶν χερουβεὶν τὸ μῆκος πήχεων εἴκοσι ,
traditions.VUL: Alæ chérubim vigínti cúbitis extendebántur ,
traditions.KJV: And the wings of the cherubims [ were ] twenty cubits long :

11.english_reference: one wing [ of the one cherub was ] five cubits , reaching to the wall of the house

traditions.WLC: כְּנַ֨ף הָ אֶחָ֜ד לְ אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֗שׁ מַגַּ֨עַת֙ לְ קִ֣יר הַ בַּ֔יִת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡ μία πτέρυξ πήχεων πέντε ἁπτομένη τοῦ τοίχου τοῦ οἴκου ,
traditions.VUL: ita ut una ala habéret cúbitos quinque et tángeret paríetem domus :
traditions.KJV: one wing [ of the one cherub was ] five cubits , reaching to the wall of the house :

11.english_reference: and the other wing [ was likewise ] five cubits , reaching to the wing of the other cherub

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ כָּנָ֤ף הָ אַחֶ֨רֶת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֔שׁ מַגִּ֕יעַ לִ כְנַ֖ף הַ כְּר֥וּב הָ אַחֵֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡ πτέρυξ ἡ ἑτέρα πήχεων πέντε ἁπτομένη τῆς πτέρυγος τοῦ χερουβεὶν τοῦ ἑτέρου .
traditions.VUL: et áltera quinque cúbitos habens , alam tángeret altérius cherub .
traditions.KJV: and the other wing [ was likewise ] five cubits , reaching to the wing of the other cherub .

12.english_reference: And [ one ] wing of the other cherub [ was ] five cubits , reaching to the wall of the house

traditions.WLC: וּ כְנַ֨ף הַ כְּר֤וּב הָ אֶחָד֙ אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֔שׁ מַגִּ֖יעַ לְ קִ֣יר הַ בָּ֑יִת
traditions.VUL: Simíliter cherub altérius ala , quinque habébat cúbitos , et tangébat paríetem :
traditions.KJV: And [ one ] wing of the other cherub [ was ] five cubits , reaching to the wall of the house :

12.english_reference: and the other wing [ was ] five cubits [ also ] , joining to the wing of the other cherub

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ כָּנָ֤ף הָ אַחֶ֨רֶת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֔שׁ דְּבֵקָ֕ה לִ כְנַ֖ף הַ כְּר֥וּב הָ אַחֵֽר
traditions.VUL: et ala eius áltera quinque cubitórum , alam cherub altérius contingébat .
traditions.KJV: and the other wing [ was ] five cubits [ also ] , joining to the wing of the other cherub .

13.english_reference: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits

traditions.WLC: כַּנְפֵי֙ הַ כְּרוּבִ֣ים הָ אֵ֔לֶּה פֹּֽרְשִׂ֖ים אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ αἱ πτέρυγες τῶν χερουβεὶν διαπεπετασμέναι πήχεων εἴκοσι ,
traditions.VUL: Igitur alæ utriúsque chérubim expánsæ erant , et extendebántur per cúbitos vigínti :
traditions.KJV: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits :

13.english_reference: and they stood on their feet

traditions.WLC: וְ הֵ֛ם עֹמְדִ֥ים עַל רַגְלֵי הֶ֖ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ αὐτὰ ἑστηκότα ἐπὶ τοὺς πόδας αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: ipsi autem stabant eréctis pédibus ,
traditions.KJV: and they stood on their feet ,

traditions.WLC: וּ פְנֵי הֶ֥ם לַ בָּֽיִת
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ πρόσωπα αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν οἶκον .
traditions.VUL: et fácies eórum erant versæ ad exteriórem domum .
traditions.KJV: and their faces [ were ] inward .

14.english_reference: And he made the vail [ of ] blue , and purple , and crimson , and fine linen

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֨עַשׂ֙ אֶת הַ פָּרֹ֔כֶת תְּכֵ֥לֶת וְ אַרְגָּמָ֖ן וְ כַרְמִ֣יל וּ ב֑וּץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ καταπέτασμα ὑακίνθου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ κοκκίνου καὶ βύσσου ,
traditions.VUL: Fecit quoque velum ex hyacíntho , púrpura , cocco , et bysso :
traditions.KJV: And he made the vail [ of ] blue , and purple , and crimson , and fine linen ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֥עַל עָלָ֖י ו כְּרוּבִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὕφανεν ἐν αὐτῷ χερουβείν .
traditions.VUL: et intéxuit ei chérubim .
traditions.KJV: and wrought cherubims thereon .

15.english_reference: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֜עַשׂ לִ פְנֵ֤י הַ בַּ֨יִת֙ עַמּוּדִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם אַמּ֕וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְ חָמֵ֖שׁ אֹ֑רֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ τοίχου στύλους δύο , πήχεων τριάκοντα πέντε τὸ ὕψος ,
traditions.VUL: Ante fores étiam templi duas colúmnas , quæ trigínta et quinque cúbitos habébant altitúdinis :
traditions.KJV: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high ,

15.english_reference: and the chapiter that [ was ] on the top of each of them [ was ] five cubits

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ צֶּ֥פֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל רֹאשׁ֖ וֹ אַמּ֥וֹת חָמֵֽשׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν πήχεων πέντε .
traditions.VUL: porro cápita eárum , quinque cubitórum .
traditions.KJV: and the chapiter that [ was ] on the top of each of them [ was ] five cubits .

16.english_reference: And he made chains , [ as ] in the oracle , and put [ them ] on the heads of the pillars

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֤עַשׂ שַׁרְשְׁרוֹת֙ בַּ דְּבִ֔יר וַ יִּתֵּ֖ן עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הָ עַמֻּדִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν σερσερὼθ ἐν τῷ δαβεὶρ καὶ ἔδωκεν ἐπὶ τῶν κεφαλῶν τῶν στύλων ,
traditions.VUL: Necnon et quasi caténulas in oráculo , et superpósuit eas capítibus columnárum :
traditions.KJV: And he made chains , [ as ] in the oracle , and put [ them ] on the heads of the pillars ;

16.english_reference: and made an hundred pomegranates , and put [ them ] on the chains

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν ῥοίσκους ἑκατὸν καὶ ἐπέθηκεν ἐπὶ τῶν χαλαστῶν .

17.english_reference: And he reared up the pillars before the temple , one on the right hand , and the other on the left

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστησεν τοὺς στύλους κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ ναοῦ , ἕνα ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ τὸν ἕνα ἐξ εὐωνύμων ,

17.english_reference: and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin , and the name of that on the left Boaz
